title: Recursion
goal: Recursion ka base case, call stack aur recursive vs iterative trade-off samajhna.
definition: Recursion tab hota hai jab function apne aap ko chhote input ke saath call kare. Har recursive function me base case (rukwat) aur recursive case (chhota problem) hona chahiye.
explain: Base case ke bina recursion infinite chalti hai aur stack overflow deti hai.
Har call ka apna stack frame hota hai: parameters, locals aur return address. Stack LIFO hai, isliye sabse pehle call sabse baad return hota hai.
Factorial, Fibonacci, digit sum, reverse, palindrome aur tree traversal recursion se natural likhe jaate hain.
Recursion memory O(depth) leti hai; deep recursion (1e6) stack overflow kar sakti hai. Iteration O(1) space deti hai — choice problem par depend karti hai.
analogy: Recursion Russian dolls jaisa hai: har doll ke andar chhoti doll, aur sabse chhoti doll (base case) par khulna rukta hai.
why: Recursion se tree/graph aur divide-and-conquer problems simple ho jaate hain — interviews me call stack explain karna strong signal hai.

syntax.note: Base case pehle likho, phir chhota input.

topics.title: Call stack
topics.body: fact(4) → fact(3) → fact(2) → fact(1), phir values wapas multiply hoti hain: 1,2,6,24. Depth n+1 frames.

topics.title: Classic recursions
topics.body: Sum(n)=n+sum(n-1), Fibonacci fib(n)=fib(n-1)+fib(n-2) (exponential — memoization se O(n)), reverse string, palindrome, GCD (Euclid), power.

topics.title: Recursion vs iteration
topics.body: Recursion code chhota aur expressive hota hai par stack use karta hai; iteration fast aur constant space. Tail recursion ko compiler optimize kar sakta hai, C guarantee nahi deta.

examples.title: Factorial aur sum
lines: Ternary base case aur recursive case dono dikhata hai.

examples.title: Fibonacci aur GCD
lines: Base case b==0 par rukta hai.

mistakes.why: Shared state recursive calls ke beech corrupt ho jaata hai.

debug.brief: Recursive sum stack overflow kar raha hai. Bug dhundo.
debug.fix: int sum(int n) { return n == 0 ? 0 : n + sum(n - 1); }

best: Recursive call chhote input par ho
Depth sochо — bade n par iteration

interview.a: Recursive call function ka last operation ho aur result par koi kaam na bache. Kuch compilers ise loop me badal dete hain, par C standard guarantee nahi deta.
interview.followUp: C me guaranteed? — nahi, manually loop likho.

interview.a: Naive recursion same subproblems dobara solve karta hai — O(2^n). Memo array se O(n) time, O(n) space.
